resCmpData.re_desc_note_fin: Notes:   (i) The financial results were reviewed by Audit Committee & approved by the Board of Directors at the meeting held on 5 Feb. 2024. The limited review for quarter & nine months ended 31 Dec. 2023, as required under Reg. 33 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 has been carried out by the Statutory Auditors.      (iii)Certain Shareholders have raised objections on related party transactions (RPTs) entered into by Linde India Ltd ( Company ) with Praxair India Pvt Ltd and Linde South Asia Services Pvt Ltd since the resolution on material RPTs in 85th AGM held on 24 June 2021 had been rejected by the shareholders. The Company has also received inquiries & information requests from SEBI in connection with certain RPTs & arrangements to which the Company has been responding. Based on the legal opinion obtained by the Company, the Company is in compliance with all requirements under SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 in respect of all RPTs entered into by it. No RPT entered into by the Company has a value in excess of the materiality threshold of 10% or more of the annual consolidated turnover of the Company.  Therefore, there are no material RPTs entered into by the Company. In terms of the legal opinion obtained by the Company, it has applied the materiality threshold of 10% or more of the annual consolidated turnover of the Company to the value of each of the RPT & not by aggregating the value of all RPTs it has entered into and ascertained that no shareholder approval is required for any RPT in terms of Reg. 23 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, which is not ���material��� in nature.      In October 2023, SEBI summoned the Managing Director and Secretary of the Company to appear before its Investigating Authority (���IA���) & has also summoned the Company to furnish certain information and documents, all in connection with its investigation into financial information & business transactions of the Company where SEBI believe there is a reasonable ground to believe that the disclosure of financial information & the business transactions have been dealt with in a manner which may be detrimental to investors or the securities markets; and/or an intermediary or person associated with the securities market & may have violated the provisions of the SEBI Act, 1992 or Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1956 or SEBI (PFUTP) Regulations, 2003 or SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. Pursuant thereto, they appeared before SEBI & also subsequently responded to the questions with information & documents. The Investigating Officer further issued summons to Independent Directors in Jan.' 2024 & sought responses to certain queries & also again sought additional documents & information from the Company. Based on legal review and advice, Writ Petitions have been filed in the Hon'ble Bombay High Court (one by all the three IDs and another by the Company) seeking a quash of the aforementioned proceedings & for stay of such proceedings in the interim. Both these Writ Petitions have been directed to be clubbed & taken for hearing on 7 Feb. 2024 by the Hon'ble Bombay High Court.      Management regularly evaluates the business & regulatory risks, including the above matters & it recognizes the related uncertainties around their ultimate outcomes, the impact of which, if any, is not presently ascertainable.
